en: The image shows a colorized historical street scene, featuring a town square bordered by classic European buildings with red-tiled roofs. Prominently, there's a building labeled 'Goldene Krone,' which appears to be a hotel and restaurant. Several people in period clothing, including women in long dresses and men in hats, are seen walking and gathering in the square. There are also business signs in German, and a horse cart is visible. The postcard includes printed text at the bottom and sides.
